incentives.name: Data center sales and use tax exemption
incentives.law: Minn. Stat. 297A.68, subd. 42; 297A.75 (amended by Laws 2025, 1st Spec. Sess. ch. 12, sec. 17)
incentives.what: Sales tax exemption for equipment and software of qualified and refurbished data centers, plus the electricity they use (electricity exemption kept). 2025 law adds qualified large-scale data centers ($250M+ within 60 months after June 30, 2025, 25,000+ sq ft): equipment and software exempt but not electricity; claim period extended from 20 to 35 years; prevailing wage required; green building certification within 3 years or repay.

dockets.what: Electric service agreement with Harmony Group, LLC (Google) for Hermantown data center
Electric service agreement with Echo Zone, LLC (Google) for Pine Island data center
PUC denied (4-0) Amazon's request to exempt 250 backup diesel generators (up to 600 MW) at Becker from a certificate of need

laws_and_bills.name: HF 16, Laws 2025 1st Special Session chapter 12 (data center regulatory bill)
laws_and_bills.what: Signed June 14, 2025. Annual fee of $2M-$5M by peak demand on qualified large-scale data centers for low-income conservation; PUC must define a very large customer class by Dec 15, 2026 (216B.1622) and protect other customers from stranded costs; optional clean energy/capacity tariff (216B.1623); DNR preapplication review and permit conditions for data centers using over 100M gallons/year; sales tax changes; defines data center as 100 MW+ design load.
